license.notes: Zoo 0.92.0. The lit wall unit behind a bar: a lower cabinet run at counter height on a recessed plinth, tiered GLASS shelves above it crowded with bottles in rows and stemware on the top tier, a brass edge rail on every shelf, pilasters dividing an ODD number of bays, a cornice, and in the CENTRE bay either a mirror (form straight) or a round lit porthole niche (form niche). Warm BULBS behind the shelves, one to a bay to a tier -- 1997, not an LED strip -- emissive as M_BackBar_bulb_Face and M_BackBar_niche_Face, the suffix Lux's power cut takes. Planned in core/back_bar_forms.py; the labels are painted in core/back_bar_art.py, one atlas a unit, and every liquor brand is INVENTED (core/liquor_brands.py, with a denylist a test holds every painted string against) -- no real mark and no Pennsylvania distiller. Lettering is Pixel Operator, CC0, via Pixelcoat. Measured over 88 builds: 1,834-8,112 triangles, zero coincident face pairs, exact slot extents. The back is the slot's +Y face; collision is the whole unit's box.
